record.name: ai.assistant – 智能AI聊天
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
认识 ai.assistant —— 一款专属的端侧私有 AI 伴侣，帮助你思考，写作与整理更清晰的内容。它使用 Apple 端侧基础模型。起草邮件，概括文章，讲解复杂主题，规划项目，并激发灵感——在 iPhone，iPad 与 Mac 上带来精致的 Apple 风格体验。

用专注的聊天模式保持高效  
选择你希望助手如何帮助你，这样更快获得所需内容：

写作 —— 把零散想法变成清晰文字。  
• 起草邮件，论文与博客文章  
• 将消息改写得更短，更友好或更专业  
• 在保留你表达风格的同时润色措辞

概括 —— 秒内抓住重点。  
• 将长文章或笔记提炼为要点  
• 生成可直接粘贴的 TL;DR 供发消息或写文档使用  
• 对比多种概括结果，快速判断哪些信息最重要

讲解 —— 更清楚地理解任何内容。  
• 拆解密集文字，概念或指引  
• 让它带你一步步理解，并用类比解释  
• 把令人困惑的讲解转成易懂的表述

规划 —— 把目标转为可执行步骤。  
• 为出行，活动或跑腿任务生成清单  
• 绘制学习安排或项目时间线  
• 将模糊想法整理成有序行动计划

激发灵感 —— 在做决定前探索更多可能。  
• 为名字，主题，功能或礼物生成创意  
• 为同一问题提供替代方案  
• 追问优缺点，帮助你理清思路

或保持在通用模式，让 ai.assistant 随对话演进自动适配每个任务。

导入 PDF 和图片，立即理解  
导入 PDF 或图片，让 ai.assistant 提取其中文字，方便你直接使用。  
• 用几条要点概括一份 20 页 PDF 的主要内容  
• 请求用通俗语言解释研究论文  
• 将扫描笔记或截图转成可编辑的干净文字  
（最多支持 50 页 PDF。）

把好答案变成可复用输出  
你喜欢的任何回复都可以变成输出（Artifact），以后随时复用。  
• 保存草稿，概括，计划，清单，测验，闪卡等  
• 按类型，主题或项目整理  
• 搜索，打标签并筛选，迅速找到正需要的内容  
• 只需几秒即可在不同 App 间复制并复用输出

输出工作室：一键重塑答案  
无需从头改写，快速把任何回复变成新格式。  
• 更精简 —— 将一页内容压缩为几句凝练表述  
• 更正式 —— 把随手笔记变成专业文字  
• 要点式 —— 把段落改成便于浏览的列表  
• 测验 —— 将主题变成练习题  
• 闪卡 —— 从关键要点生成间隔复习风格卡片  
先预览效果，再保存到输出中以备后用。

打造真正好用的个人资料库  
把笔记，摘录与粘贴内容存成自己的参考资料库。  
• 收集研究资料，会议纪要或关键段落  
• 生成快速 AI 概括，让每一条都便于浏览  
• 之后可按关键词搜索，迅速回想当时的要点

Ari（可选）：带个性与温柔引导  
开启 Ari，为教练式陪伴加入轻量角色层。  
• 当你卡住时获得安静而有支持性的轻推  
• 一键操作，如 简化，生成清单 或 优化措辞风格  
• 调整 Ari 的表现力度，让其更贴合你的风格

以隐私为先的设计  
你的内容保存在设备上，而不是集中到通用档案。  
• 通过 CloudKit 的可选 iCloud 同步，让数据在 Apple 设备间保持更新  
• 通过 StoreKit 由 Apple 安全处理购买

Ari+  
升级解锁更强大的付费工具，让你能与 ai.assistant 做得更多：  
• 支持为 PDF 和图片导入文件  
• 输出工作室中的高级转换  
• 扩展 AI 工具，更适合更高要求的写作，规划与学习流程

使用条款（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

有问题，随时问 AI。

从一个简单的想法开始，让 AI 帮助你完成更多内容创作。

支持文案生成、内容改写、文字润色、内容扩写、表达优化和创意构思等多种需求。无论是工作中的文字内容，还是日常创作和社交分享，都可以借助 AI 快速寻找灵感。

无论是日常交流、寻找灵感还是练习表达，都可以用更方便的方式与 AI 互动。

从一句描述、一个灵感开始，探索 AI 带来的更多创作可能。

O aplicativo Microsoft Copilot é a IA desenvolvida para o trabalho. O Copilot ajuda você a manter seu trabalho em andamento, desde ideias iniciais até documentos finalizados, apresentações e muito mais. Se você está criando conteúdo, gerenciando projetos, organizando seu dia ou encontrando informações, o Copilot ajuda você a fazer mais em um só lugar.

O Copilot se conecta ao Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams e muito mais, reunindo os arquivos e as informações que você usa em um só lugar. Crie documentos, apresentações e planilhas sofisticados, resuma artigos e arquivos, redija e-mails, discuta ideias, analise informações e obtenha respostas com base no trabalho que você está fazendo.

Precisa de ajuda para realizar uma tarefa maior? Com o Cowork, o Copilot pode realizar trabalhos em várias etapas e ajudar a entregar arquivos finalizados e tarefas concluídas, para que você passe menos tempo juntando peças e mais tempo progredindo.

Escolha entre os principais modelos de IA, selecionando aquele que é mais adequado para a tarefa em questão. Se você está escrevendo, pesquisando, planejando ou analisando, o Copilot oferece a flexibilidade de trabalhar do seu jeito.

O Copilot também lembra o que importa, se conecta aos arquivos e às informações que você mais usa e ajuda você a continuar de onde parou. Faça upload de arquivos do Word, Excel, PowerPoint, imagens ou PDF diretamente do seu telefone para fazer perguntas, gerar resumos e encontrar as informações de que você precisa.

Para organizações com uma assinatura do Microsoft 365 Copilot, o Work IQ oferece ao Copilot uma profunda
compreensão do trabalho, das pessoas e dos relacionamentos de sua organização, oferecendo assistência mais inteligente, relevante, personalizada e confiável.

O Copilot é construído sobre a mesma base de segurança de nível empresarial do Microsoft 365 — suas permissões, criptografia e compromissos de conformidade já estão em vigor. Os compromissos de processamento e proteção de dados variam de acordo com a assinatura; consulte a documentação de segurança completa para obter detalhes.

Voxmate brings together information about people, past conversations, and relevant context to help you prepare before an important meeting or conversation.
Get the background you need, identify key topics, and walk into every conversation better prepared.

Don't let important conversations slip away.
Record meetings, calls, interviews, and everyday conversations with minimal effort. voxmate transcribes conversations, recognizes speakers, and lets you quickly mark the moments that matter.

Understanding a conversation is only the beginning.
Voxmate identifies what needs to happen next and turns conversations into concrete actions — from follow-ups and tasks to decisions and next steps.
Turn what was said into what needs to happen next.

Go beyond identifying an action.
Voxmate can help move work forward by drafting follow-up messages, creating tasks, preparing content, and connecting actions to the tools you already use.

Some work happens again and again.
With Routines, you can turn recurring workflows into repeatable AI-powered processes.

Set up the workflow once, and let voxmate help handle it the next time it happens.

Your conversations shouldn't become isolated recordings.
Voxmate connects your conversations with people, projects, files, actions, and history, so you can continue asking questions and following up long after a conversation ends.
The more you work with voxmate, the more it understands how you work, who you work with, and how you like to get things done — helping your AI become increasingly personalized to you.

Your conversations and work information are yours.
Voxmate is built with privacy and security at its core, giving you control over your information while helping you get more value from it.
Built for Real Work, Wherever It Happens
Whether you're in a meeting, on a call, talking with a customer, or moving between conversations throughout the day, voxmate helps you capture what matters and keep work moving.

Voxmate doesn't just record conversations.

Know who you're meeting and what to focus on.

Get the background you need, identify key topics, and walk into every conversation better prepared.

Don't let important conversations slip away.

Stay focused on the conversation while voxmate captures the details.

Turn what was said into what needs to happen next.

From action to execution, with less manual work.

Your conversations and work information are yours.

record.description_evidence:
告别那些需要不断点击、滚动和切换的旧式效率工具、计划表、提醒 App 和待办清单。开口说，Codot 帮你记住一切。

Codot 是你的全能语音助手：一个用于生活事务和工作效率的个人 AI 助手与整理器。无论你需要安排日程的虚拟助手、快速记录灵感和脑暴的语音笔记 App，还是帮你掌控流程的智能任务管理器，Codot 都能完成。

Codot 适合谁
• 同时盯着客户、合同和一百件零碎事的创业者和老板
• 想到什么必须当下就记下来、不然转眼就忘的 ADHD 用户
• 在外面跑的线下经营者：装修承包商、房产经纪、美容店和门店老板——手上忙着活、办公桌就是车前座的人

Codot 的 AI Agent 会学习你的习惯，提供更聪明的日程安排；任务日历可与 Apple Calendar 无缝同步，把你的一天整合到一起。它是装进口袋里的任务管理器、个人计划器和专注 App。

特别适合 ADHD 和忙碌的大脑
如果你常常难以专注，Codot 就是为你设计的。专注计时器帮助你保持节奏，智能自动化处理琐碎管理工作。不再被各种待办压垮，只留下清晰优先级和温和提醒。

为什么你会喜欢这款效率 App

全能语音助手：任务、日历、笔记、CRM、支出、健康、团队协作，以及更多用法。你可以发明自己的 Codot 使用方式，只要问 Codot Agent。

轻松语音记录：语音转文字，把想法即时整理成待办。快速笔记从未如此简单。

智能提醒 App：在正确的时间收到正确通知。Codot 会学习你的日常节奏并自动适应。

智能日程与个人计划器：
像和助手聊天一样对 Codot 说话，它会像私人秘书一样整理你的日程。比如说：“明天提醒我买牛奶，周五晚上 8 点给 Jack 打电话，周末去网球俱乐部，还要明天提交申请。”这个带自动化能力的每日计划器会学习你的习惯，并在正确时间提醒你。

完整任务管理器：整理、排序，并让 Codot 根据你的工作模式建议下一步。

番茄钟：追踪你的时间和可计费工时。

语音笔记与脑暴：把想法直接说出来，Codot 会用语音转文字转录，并由 AI 自动打标签，整理成笔记。不用打字，只要说。随时问 Codot 关于你的笔记，它会替你记住一切。

保存内容：一键保存来自 X、Reddit、网页或小红书的链接。Codot 会在合适的时间重新呈现并关联它们，让收藏不再吃灰。

CRM：语音 CRM。你只要说，Codot 会归类到 CRM，并在合适时间提醒你维护关系。

会议笔记助手：把任何想法或会议记录丢进 Codot，变成你的个人离线知识库。

日历同步：与 Apple Calendar 漂亮协作，Google Calendar 即将推出。

AI 洞察：询问 Codot 你什么时候最高效、上周聊过什么、哪些任务需要注意。它是你的个人数据助手。

停止在多个 App 间点击、滚动、切换来艰难规划。开始使用一个真正理解你生活的语音助手。

下载 Codot，你的全能语音 AI 助手，让它跑好你的一天。

AI NOTE-TAKER
Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings to capture decisions, outcomes, and next steps so you can stay focused on the conversation.

Get context and insights from any meeting you have access to using natural language. Generate documents, automate email follow-ups, memos, and CRMs instantly. Everything discussed becomes searchable, actionable, and ready to ship with a single click.

AI ACTION ITEMS
Ensure nothing falls through the cracks from every meeting, even the ones you don't attend. Fellow automatically surfaces and assigns action items based on discussions, so meeting follow-ups are fully automated.

MANAGE YOUR CALENDAR AND UPCOMING MEETINGS
Show up to every meeting prepared no matter where you are. View your full calendar, toggle recording on or off before meetings start, and edit agenda items on the go, so you always show up prepared and ready to contribute.


Note: This app is meant to be used with an existing Fellow account.
